description.value:
On a detachable-magazine rifle, sniper rifle or shotgun held two-handed: when it runs dry, reload by giving up your Move Action. Then it's spent until reset (an Action). Not concealable, no Popup Weapon.

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)
Fits: All Assault Rifles, Sniper Rifles, and Shotguns that use detachable magazines (e.g., double barrel shotguns are not compatible) and do not have an equipped Belt Box or Backpack Magazine

Item Compendium (2070) • Attachments & Mods
